content_blocks.label: clause_1._EXECUTION
content_blocks.text: I, Alexander S. White, of Riverdale Town, State of Novaria, do hereby execute this Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My entire estate, including all personal property, real property, and financial assets, shall be distributed according to the provisions set forth herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTORS
content_blocks.text: I appoint my niece, Emily L. Gray, as Executor of this Will, with full power and authority to carry out the provisions of this Will.
